meta.title: Insight intelligence | Immersive Analytics Workspace
meta.description: Dashboards stay alive with narrative context, not just charts.

sections.title: Dashboards stay alive with narrative context, not just charts.
sections.body:
Usage, quality, and momentum are measured together. The companion reveals where attention goes, which prompts deliver impact,
and how costs are trending—all while linking back to the exact conversations that created each insight.

primary.label: Companion analytics
primary.body: Trace the health of sessions, prompts, API fetches, and downstream actions. Filter by team, data domain, or campaign and understand how the assistant is amplifying impact across the organisation.
primary.noteBody: Each card blends metrics with the conversation that produced them. Jump directly to the prompt, the transformation plan, or the async worker run that impacted the result.

secondary.label: Automation health
secondary.body: Monitor worker queues, job retries, API polling cadence, and refresh cycles. When the companion escalates a heavy task, you can see the outcome and cost impact immediately.
secondary.note: Configure alerts to ping the right channel when usage spikes, cost budgets are close, or momentum slips.

sections.title: Insights arrive as briefings your stakeholders can act on.
sections.body: The companion pairs each data update with language crafted for the audience it serves—operators, executives, or partners. It cites sources, anticipates objections, and recommends next moves grounded in data pulled from files, APIs, and authorised web captures.

items.title: Contextual recall
items.body: Jump from a chart back to the conversation that birthed it. Every insight links to prompts, transformations, API calls, and worker outputs.

items.title: Audience tuning
items.body: Toggle tone and depth per audience while preserving the underlying facts. The assistant rewrites copy instantly.

items.title: Momentum archive
items.body: Review how decisions evolved over time, identify seasonal patterns, and spotlight the conversations that moved the needle most.
